text_block_list.name: TV Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—The gates open!! And in her quest for her 
first American Oaks title, Cesario is off 
to a brilliant start!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(Again, and again, and again, and again, 
and again...)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(The growth projection for Cesario-san 
that Trainer and I put together, revising 
it over and over again...)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(To build up enough strength to surpass it 
by autumn. This is something we assembled, 
analyzed, and thought through with every 
ounce of our effort.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(She surpassed it without breaking a 
sweat.)

text_block_list.name: TV Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"—Commanding the lead!! Cesario enters the 
final straight out in front!"

text_block_list.name: TV Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Cesario takes the lead and pulls even 
further away from the pack! Maintaining a 
three-length lead, she crosses under 200 
meters to go!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: TV Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"It's Cesario, Cesario!! There's no way 
Cesario loses this now! A lead of four, 
five lengths!!"

text_block_list.name: TV Commentary
text_block_list.text: "...Cesaarrriioooo!! Cesario did it!!"

text_block_list.name: TV Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"The winning time is 1 minute 59.03 
seconds! Without slowing down a bit, she 
crosses the finish line in a solo 
runaway!!"

text_block_list.name: TV Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Japan's Tiara Umamusume, Cesario!! For 
the first time in history, a Japanese 
Umamusume has conquered the American 
Oaks!!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: (Ah...――Ah!! I knew it, I knew it――)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: (She's "promoted"! Her, too...!)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: A monster...!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you for waiting, Trainer-san. 
Preparations are complete.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I will be in your care... today as well.

Sharpening our skills intensely during an 
overnight stay... Some time has passed 
since the summer training camp began.

Training was progressing more or less as 
planned, but... Air Messiah's expression 
was somewhat somber.

Although, the reason for that is obvious. 
...They simply cannot forget the shocking 
run that Cesario displayed.

"Besides, the final leg of the Triple 
Tiara, the 'Shuka Sho,' is also the race 
held dearest in her heart—"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Eh, pardon?
choice_data_list:
If you have anything you need to discuss, 
please let me know.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. My sincerest apologies. I've done 
nothing but show you my pathetic side.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine. I understand, after all. What I 
must do, and what I can do—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
All that can be done…… is to keep building 
on it.

And a little while after the summer 
training camp began, one day—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Messiah! Good work out there. ...Hey, 
did you hear?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "It's about Cesario. Look—the news."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: The news? ...!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Cesario-san is... injured?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Severe discomfort in the right leg"— 
"While daily life and training pose no 
issues, all scheduled race entries have 
been temporarily wiped clean"—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Thus, the stable has officially announced 
that she will 'bypass the Shuka Sho'..."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —Honestly! What a shame!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: What a shame. Right, Messiah?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ! A... huh?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"After seeing such a performance—such 
sheer power demonstrated at the American 
Oaks, after all."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Clashing heads and crushing everyone at 
the Shuka Sho! I was looking forward to 
making my claim and declaring myself the 
new Queen, too."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"To think you'd withdraw—what a pity! 
...Well, whatever, that's that—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I will show them an overwhelming run at 
the Shuka Sho that will overwrite even 
their most vivid memories. ...That is all 
there is to it!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: (Disappointing... Was it 'disappointing'?)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(Am I... disappointed that I couldn't face 
Cesario in the Shuka Sho...?)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(...I can't see it that way. —There's no 
way I ever could!!)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...As expected of Daring Heart-san.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ? What was that? —What? Messiah?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: No.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: As expected... What a monstrous mentality.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(I can't think that way, there's no way I 
ever could, not like you!!)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
No... ...I'm just relieved. I feel at 
peace.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
They said I don't have to compete against 
Cesario-san. They said I don't have to 
fight a monster like that anymore.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Because... because I...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: She's not a monster, not at all.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: (...Mother.)

text_block_list.name: Young Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Incredible... Incredible, incredible, 
incredible! Mother came in 1st place...!!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu, yes, at the Queen Stakes. Even 
though I hadn't won any races besides my 
debut, everyone still favored me as the 
number one pick..."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
""My very first graded race victory 
happened right here. ...I was proud. Truly 
proud.""

text_block_list.name: Young Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa...! And then, you were the first 
favorite in the Shuka Sho too! Because you 
lived up to everyone's expectations!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"...That's true. Even though I fell just 
short in the Oka Sho and the Oaks, so many 
people still cheered me on—"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text: ‘However... ngh.’

text_block_list.name: Young Messiah
text_block_list.text: ""? Mother...?""

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"...No, I'm sorry. Ngh... I'm sorry, just 
for a moment—"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: (Mother... Mother...)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(About the Shuka Sho where she finished 
3rd. Mother told me about it, choking up 
over her words again and again.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
—Just remembering it makes my blood boil! 
The image of my mother's tears seared into 
my eyes comes back so vividly!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I must win! The Shuka Sho... This Shuka 
Sho of all races, I must!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
None other than me!! I am her daughter, 
and I—!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ......And yet.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Against monsters like that...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...I don't feel like... I can win――!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Even until now... I've built myself up. 
I've steadily, reliably aimed for growth.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Think about what's necessary for victory. 
Set up the wall, understand its height. 
And make a plan to overcome it."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
One day at a time! One step at a time! 
Because... that's the only way I know how!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: However—they are different.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"The walls that take me a hundred days to 
finally overcome... they leap right over 
them in just a matter of days."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Then what am I supposed to do about 
that?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: What do I have to do to win...?!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Hah, hah...!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(...Oh no. My voluntary training... I 
overdid it compared to the plan—)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(I wonder how I should write this in my 
daily report... To Trainer—)

"If there is anything you wish to consult 
about, please don't hesitate to speak up."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Still... not like this...!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(I can't say it! ...I can't say it, no 
matter what! Precisely because it's him, 
there's no way—!)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(I can't say it! ...I can't say it, no 
matter what! Precisely because it's her, 
there's no way—!)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Because... ...even though you believed in 
me.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(Even though you believed in me and walked 
this path together with me! 'Solidly, 
steadily.' That that was my true 
strength!)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(Even though you believed in someone like 
me... and walked this path together with 
me...!)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
And yet, to think that I'm the one... 
who's beginning to doubt it.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...I can't say it! I don't... want to say 
it—!!
